scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev:infra && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && sleep 2 && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.cicd:frontend: pnpm --filter mobile lint && pnpm --filter mobile format:check && pnpm --filter mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @coco/shared lint && pnpm --filter mobile test
scripts.cicd:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright && SILICON_API_KEY=test TENCENT_SECRET_ID=test TENCENT_SECRET_KEY=test DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://test:test@localhost:5432/test JWT_SECRET=test uv run pytest -x -q
